title: Federal Register exposed using Alibaba Cloud’s Qwen model
teaser: A search interface on the US Federal Register, the government’s official journal, briefly exposed two options built on Alibaba Cloud’s Qwen3:0.6B model. The models disappeared a little more than a day after a screenshot began circulating, turning a routine search feature into an awkward signal about the economics of AI in government. The episode does not show that sensitive data left the US; the Federal Register is public. It does show that a low-cost Chinese model was considered useful enough for a federal document-search tool.
